prerequisite: All 12085 official cell-a Parquet files projected and audited; never train from the pilot as though complete
forecasting: Only completed JOB CPU/memory records in past bins. Future workload is forecast by frozen TimesFM3, never actual future CPU. Capacity is a historical scheduler-available feature.
selection: First four development dates choose family/checkpoint, two fixed neural seeds averaged. Last four dates choose blend by paired day one-standard-error preferring lower new weight. One cell has real CPU; cell-based SE would always reject a single-cell correction, so day units are declared before this experiment.
scope: Ridge candidates change cell-a PDUs only; all other domains exactly equal frozen round8b prior. Neural candidates may change all 57 domains. Report both 57-domain and 5-domain scores with matched controls.
initialization: Fusion encoder initializes from corresponding round5 seed and fitting cutoff. Power residual output reinitialized to zero around existing calibrated ensemble. Extra resource embedding initializes at zero.
constraints: Power quantiles in [0,1], CPU NCU quantiles >=0 and ordered. No CPU<=Power or CPU<=scheduler-capacity constraint.
limitations: Same May2019 test repeatedly inspected in past rounds; freezing this selection prevents new test-driven changes but cannot restore independence. Full export coverage does not imply complete physical telemetry.
final_attribution: Always final-fit all three Ridge feature groups at the early-development best Ridge alpha and all four neural ablations at one common epoch. If overall winner is neural, its epoch is common; otherwise choose full-CPU neural epoch on early development. Retain matched tests without using test ranks to change selection.
monotone_branch: Two per-PDU coefficients on history-only forecast CPU and memory changes, constrained >=0, Ridge penalties 10/100/1000. Matched intercept-only control at each penalty. Corrections around frozen ensemble; positivity means conditional monotonicity, not complete power conservation. All six fit on final training and report without test-based reselection.
